blocks.text: Why a Chauffeur Makes Sense in Dana Point
Three practical reasons, specific to this city.
blocks.html: Three practical reasons, specific to this city.

items: Doheny and Salt Creek beaches have very limited parking, so wedding-party vehicles end up circling, which a staged coach removes.
Monarch Beach alone can house hundreds of guests spread across buildings and lawns, making internal shuttling a real service.
Pacific Coast Highway through Dana Point is effectively one lane each way at peak hours and gridlocks at sunset.
Wedding weekends routinely split groups between Dana Point, San Juan Capistrano and Laguna Beach, roughly 10-15 miles apart.

blocks.text: We also quote Dana Point to the hour rather than the trip. blocks.text: Choosing a Vehicle for a Dana Point Night

Capacity is the first filter, then cost per person. A stretch limo seats 6 to 8, a Chrysler 300 about 8, a Hummer 12, and a Sprinter limo up to 14. Our party bus seats 24. Below about ten people, two cars or a limo usually beats a bus. Above ten, the bus wins on cost per head and nobody gets left behind.

Our drivers work the night and do not drink, which matters when the group includes teenagers, and we set a fixed return time off the venue's posted close so nobody is standing in a parking lot at 1 AM wondering where the car went.
